children: Fox has released a list of U.S. business leaders expected to attend the China-U.S. state dinner scheduled for this Thursday at the White House. According to ChainCatcher, the list includes Tesla CEO Elon Musk, Amazon founder Jeff Bezos, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai, Dell Technologies founder Michael Dell, Apple Executive Chairman Tim Cook, Citigroup Chair Jane Fraser, and Qualcomm President Cristiano Amon.

title: Fox Releases List of U.S. Business Leaders for China-U.S. State Dinner at the White House
